earnings.title: Roper Technologies announces third quarter financial results
highlights: Revenue increased 8% to $2.17 billion; organic revenue was +7% and acquisition contribution was +1%

quotes.text: Roper delivered another solid quarter, with 8% total revenue growth, 7% organic revenue growth, 7% EBITDA growth, and 15% adjusted DEPS growth.
quotes.by: Neil Hunn, Roper Technologies' President and CEO

outlook: Roper now expects full year 2026 adjusted DEPS of $22.35 - $22.40, compared to previous guidance of $22.15 - $22.30.
For the fourth quarter of 2026, the Company expects adjusted DEPS of $5.95 - $6.00.
